theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_tba_plane_cutoff_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ → κ < 1 → (unitBallVolume n).toReal * (1 - κ) ^ n ≤ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), max 0 (min 1 ((1 - ‖y‖) / κ)) ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), max 0 (min 1 ((1 + κ - ‖y‖) / κ)) ∂μHE[n] ≤ (unitBallVolume n).toReal * (1 + κ) ^ n
